question: A meeting of the archbishops of the witch cult (literally ‘witch today’, probably a typo). I’d like to see how the dramatic conversation between those rich personalities turns out.
answer: With that bunch, having them all meet in one place is not going to happen, you know. Once, I thought about putting an emergency meeting after Petelgeuse’s death into the interlude, but Sirius was crying her eyes out, and the rest of the conference was just mocking laughter from the others, so I decided against it.
